decisions.reason: As a multi-model dental line closely tied to the firm's core materials business, it likely remains near aspiration levels and the expected gains from continued exploitation still exceed the value of redeploying its resources.

This thermoforming blank fits established laboratory workflows and production capabilities, so despite limited recent visibility it is still plausible that performance is acceptable enough to retain while monitoring its contribution.

Because this ancillary material was only lightly featured and has had several years to prove itself, management would be more likely to judge it as falling short of aspiration and reallocate resources to stronger lines or new development.
Custom earmolds are highly complementary to the firm's hearing-care customer base, custom manufacturing skills, and international channels, making continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Although it uses existing earmold capabilities, this more niche hearing-protection line is more exposed to below-aspiration results after several years, so a boundedly rational management would slightly favor redeployment of resources.
